title: Et Cetera: Every High School Movie Ever
original_title: Et Cetera: Every High School Movie Ever
overview: Teen Etsy is the least popular girl in school-until a makeover skyrockets her to fame. Watch as she and her platonic best friend Blank navigate love and popularity in this genre parody of high school movies from the 80s, 90s, and early 2000s.
